subject: West Tower — interop & on-site ops for Nov 30 enterprise workshop

Cc: Oliver Park <oliver.park@avpartners.io>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 08:15:00 -0500
Subject: West Tower — AV interconnect + room assignment check for 30 Nov workshop

Hi Rafael —

Thanks for confirming Redwood's workshop on Nov 30. A couple of notes from our side as we start assignments:

- We have three contiguous rooms on the West Tower 7th floor (Rooms 701/702/703). Combined capacity with cabling is ~140 theater or ~80 classroom.
- Building IT requires a network interconnect spec if you need a dedicated VLAN for streaming/recording.
- Our in-house AV partner (AV Partners) can provide codec bridging and house mics; external partners are allowed but need to test at least 48 hours prior.

Questions for you:
1) Expected headcount on Nov 30 (peak and average)?
2) Will you require a dedicated Zoom bridge + local recording to our NFS?
3) Any embargoed attendees or special security (SCIF-like) needs?

Attaching the latest floorplan (v2) and our standard AV patch matrix. Oliver is copied to help scope the patching/cabling.

Best,

Maya Geller
Senior Events Producer
Riverside Events

Subject: Re: West Tower — AV interconnect + room assignment check for 30 Nov workshop

Thanks Maya — good detail. Quick answers up-front:
- Peak headcount expected: 92 (senior execs, breakout hosts, and ~20 observers).
- Yes: we need a dedicated Zoom bridge with local recording (primary), plus a redundant bridge as failover.
- No SCIF needs; however, a small set (4) of attendees will need private side rooms for confidential 1:1s — please hold Room 703 as a reserve.

Evelyn/Marcus — can you confirm if Redwood will bring our hardware (2 comp codecs, 4 boundary mics, logger laptop) or if we should route it through Oliver/AV Partners? Key constraints: we want sub-250ms glass-to-glass latency for the remote exec panel and NFS drop for recordings.

Action items: 
- Marcus: inventory check + travel kit confirmation by EOD Thursday (11/12).
- Evelyn: confirm network/VLAN requirements with IT + list of whitelisted IPs; copy Laura for procurement lead time on rentals.
- Maya: hold Room 703 as private reserve and confirm load-in windows.

-Rafael

> - Peak headcount expected: 92...

Quick update after calling IT and talking to Oliver:
- IT can provision a temporary VLAN (vlan-701-redwood) scoped to the West Tower rooms; they need the final list of public endpoints and an IP allowlist by 11/20.
- Oliver's crew can provide the codec pair and program redundant SIP/ZRTP fallback, but he requests a 2-hour onsite dry-run the day before (11/29) and a 90-min bridge smoke test at 08:30 on 11/30.
- Recommended AV lineup (high level): 2x HD codecs (primary/backup), 4x boundary mics per room, 2x ceiling cameras per room, on-site tech desk with switch-managed networks. See short equipment list below.

Equipment (Evelyn recommended):
- Codecs: Tandberg/Poly equivalent (we bring)
- Mixers: 1x small-form digital mixer (we'll rent if not available)
- Record logger: 1x MacBook with local NFS mount provided by Maya
- Patch: dual redundant LAN drops to the main rack; Oliver to run patch labeling.

Attachments: I uploaded the draft site survey checklist and an AV patch CSV to the shared Drive. Oliver, please confirm your preferred patch colors and whether you require additional power runs.

Evelyn Hart
Onsite Events & AV Lead

Subject: Final: West Tower interop & load-in plan (Nov 29–30)

All — thanks for the quick turn. Finalized plan below; please treat as the single source of truth.

1) Room assignment & headcount- Rooms 701/702 combined = main workshop (seated 80, standing 20).- Room 703 = reserved private suite for 1:1s and secure side meetings (locked during main sessions).

2) AV & bridges- Primary Zoom bridge (ID: 9876543210) + local NFS recording (filename pattern: redwood_20261130_session-{room}-{hhmm}.mp4).- Redundant SIP bridge to AV Partners as hot standby (Oliver will provide SIP credentials to IT).

3) Load-in & test windows- 11/29 14:00–18:00: full equipment load-in and 2-hour dry-run (Oliver onsite).- 11/30 06:30–08:30: final cable check and 08:30–10:00: 90-min smoke test with remote exec panel.

4) Network & security- Evelyn: supply final allowlist (IPs + domain names) by 11/20.- Maya: please confirm NFS mount path & credentials for logger by 11/22.

5) Logistics & travel- Marcus: confirm travel kit & courier pickup for codecs on 11/28 EOD.- Laura: procurement to finalize rental P.O. and confirm delivery window to West Tower loading dock.

6) Contacts- Redwood onsite lead: Evelyn Hart (mobile: +1-415-555-0199)- Venue lead: Maya Geller (events line: +1-212-555-0101)- AV partner tech lead: Oliver Park (oliver.park@avpartners.io)
